title: Finite selection of module-valued geometric stalk tests
statement: For Noetherian X, finite commutative Lambda and constructible module sheaf F [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], let G_l be any family of module sheaves indexed by a type L in any universe and phi_l : F -> G_l. If at every geometric point some phi_l is stalk-injective [def-weil-geometric-point, def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], there are n and l : Fin n -> L with monomorphic biproduct lift of phi_{l(i)} [def-weil-additive-category]. No finiteness or constructibility of G_l is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the underlying-set constructibility comparison to the source. Install the Mathlib colimit-preservation instance for ModuleCat.forget₂. Convert the injective module stalk map to a monomorphism; forgetting to abelian groups preserves it. The natural sheafFiberCompIso identifies this arrow with the geometric stalk of the forgotten sheaf map. Transport monomorphy along its induced arrow isomorphism and use AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective.

Apply the abelian finite-selection lemma: select generic-stalk tests on finitely many irreducible lisse strata and propagate the resulting injections across each stratum. Exact and conservative geometric stalks give a mono abelian biproduct lift.

Enumerate the selected Finset subtype by Fintype.equivFin. To show the module lift is monomorphic, take two arrows with equal composites. Project their equality onto the coordinate corresponding to each selected index. Apply the faithful sheafCompose forgetful functor to these component equalities. Biproduct hom_ext makes their composites with the selected abelian lift equal, and cancellation of that monomorphism gives equality after forgetting. Faithfulness gives equality of the original arrows. This avoids any biproduct-preservation comparison; the empty index set works as well.

theorem exists_mono_biproduct_of_constructible_module_stalk_injective
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F)
    (L : Type w) (G : L → Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (φ : ∀ l : L, F ⟶ G l)
    (hφ : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
      ∃ l : L, Function.Injective
        (((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map (φ l))) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → L), Mono (biproduct.lift (fun i : Fin n ↦ φ (l i)))
